items.q: Dalai Lama. He said, “Well we can‟t live without hope,”

ctx.x: Dalai Lama. He said, “Well we can‟t live without hope,” which is very true. And I thought, “I‟m going to make this more like a piece of anti-war, anti-nuclear weapon, weapon-anything, and it was … and we will not … uh, give up hope that someday maybe people will tolerate each other [chuckles slightly], and at least there‟s no war. And we keep saying that, we keep just saying that to the world, you know. That’s the way I wanted to write, and I think that‟s, that‟s what I think I wrote. So it‟s a very long piece, a…
